corrected_content.problem: Find a Cartesian equation of the plane that passes through the point $P(-3,2,4)$ and is parallel to the vectors ${\mathbf{v}}_{\mathbf{1}}=⟨1,-2,-5⟩$ and ${\mathbf{v}}_{\mathbf{2}}=⟨0,1,-7⟩.$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Take the cross product of the two direction vectors to obtain a normal vector:

$$
\mathbf{n}=\langle1,-2,-5\rangle\times\langle0,1,-7\rangle=\langle19,7,1\rangle.
$$

Using the point $P(-3,2,4)$, we obtain

$$
19(x+3)+7(y-2)+(z-4)=0.
$$

Therefore, a Cartesian equation is

$$
19x+7y+z+39=0.
$$
